title: AERON_flight_model_cooked node extension
description: Data that aeron_gltf_cook computes for a node of an AERON_flight_model asset. Only cooked files contain it. The model root has renderData and probeData, and each component has simulationData. Unknown fields are ignored.

vec3.title: Vector
vec3.description: A vector in the Aeron frame (the model frame). Positions are in metres.

simulationData.title: Simulation data
simulationData.description: The bounding volume hierarchy used for the component's collision, written by aeron_gltf_cook. When it is missing, the loader builds it and prints a warning. Stale or malformed data fails the load.

bufferView.title: Buffer view
bufferView.description: The buffer view holding the data.

topologyHash.description: The hash of the simulation topology that the data was built from (the collision child's mesh, otherwise the render mesh).

renderData.title: Render data
renderData.description: The bounding volume hierarchy of the merged render triangles, written by aeron_gltf_cook. When it is missing, the loader builds it and prints a warning. Stale or malformed data fails the load.

bufferView.title: Buffer view
bufferView.description: The buffer view holding the data.

meshHash.description: The hash of the merged render triangles that the data was built from.

probeData.title: Probe data
probeData.description: The model's baked probes and the layout used for the bake, written by aeron_gltf_cook --probes. Only cooked files contain it. Positions and sizes are in metres in the Aeron frame. Images that do not match the layout fail the load.

cubes.title: Cubes
cubes.description: The buffer view of a KTX2 array of square BC6H or RGBA16F cube maps with roughness mips. Layer k holds probe k.

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: The buffer view of a KTX2 image with one RGBA16F level of 6 rx by ry rz texels. Point (x, y, z) uses column 6 x + f and row y + ry z, for f = 0 to 5. RGB is the irradiance / pi toward +x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z, and A is the luminance of the mean radiance.

size.description: The full extent of the box that the grid lights fully.

gridResolution.description: Points per axis, placed at (i + 1) / (resolution + 1) of the box.
